items.title: Bloom Energy wins abroad while Texas turns against data centers
items.summary: Bloom Energy just landed its largest international project yet. Back home, a new governor’s promise has investors asking what comes next.

items.title: Bloom Energy Stock Rallies as Barclays Turns Bullish on California Power Partnership
items.summary: BE stock climbed after Barclays upgraded shares and the company announced plans to evaluate a potential 1 GW fuel-cell power project in California.

items.title: Bloom Energy Just Dropped 12% in a Week. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy fell 12% in the past week as Democrats’ midterm sweep sank AI stocks, despite new deals with NTT DATA and California Resources. Bloom made 97% of its third-quarter revenue in the US, so slower US data-center approvals are the main risk, and Oracle’s spending is the thing to watch.

items.title: Google Is Spending $17 Billion on a Wyoming Data Center and Says It Will Pay for 100% of Its Power
items.summary: Google just answered the loudest objection to AI data centers, yet the market barely noticed and one key supplier tumbled. The fine print on who supplies the power, and what the pledge leaves out, may matter more than the headline.

items.title: Bloom Energy Rises 2%, AMD Up 8% as AI Stocks Rebound From Midterm Rout
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy rose 2% today as AI stocks, AMD among them, bounced back from Thursday’s post-midterm selloff. Bloom had just landed a 900-megawatt NTT DATA deal and a 1-gigawatt plan with California Resources.
